prompt:

Person: Mateo, who is cautious about neighborhood rumors but sometimes believes them.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.

Message: "Starting next month the neighborhood council will fine anyone who leaves their bins on the sidewalk after 8am."
text: The neighborhood council is officially cracking down and will be issuing heavy fines to anyone caught leaving bins out even a minute past 8am. It’s definitely happening, so make sure you’re careful or you’ll be hit with a penalty.
